entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-25
entry.content:

    12.0.0
  • EnC in a collectible AssemblyLoadContext fails the CodeVersionManager::IsMethodSupported assert on checked runtimes #138256
  • StressLogAnalyzer rejects a log from a runtime built from the same commit: "Unsupported data descriptor version '0'" #138255

  • ControlledExecution.Run(action, CancellationToken.None) never returns #138253
  • CookieContainer: when a Set-Cookie has both Expires and Max-Age, the first one wins instead of Max-Age #138251
    Future

Closed

  • Allow building on FreeBSD/i386 #114705

  • .NET 10 JIT miscompile: Avx.AndNot(Avx.Compare(...), x) #136130

    12.0.0
  • System.Text.Json: constructors mixing out and regular parameters fail to deserialize #137797
  • [API Proposal]: #138261
